edges.reason: Owned constructor derives the initial owner from the untrusted msg.sender.
owner state variable is assigned msg.sender during construction.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner to gate transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transfer debits the caller-controlled msg.sender balance.
approve writes the allowance entry for msg.sender.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall sets the allowance of msg.sender and forwards it to the callback.
safeAdd performs uint addition a + b.
safeSub performs uint subtraction a - b.
safeMul performs uint multiplication a * b.
safeDiv performs uint division a / b.
